image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a wet, rocky substrate. The subject displays a characteristic elongated oval shape with eight distinct, overlapping dorsal plates (valves) surrounded by a textured, leathery girdle. The lighting is natural, highlighting the moisture on the shell and the rough texture of the surrounding rock.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A thick, textured band of tissue (the girdle) clearly surrounds the perimeter of the plates, embedding them securely.
